d:
Bibisi duniya men aaj dekhie,
• eeran ne ilaqe men barhae apne hamle
• filipins pahunche ameriki rashtrapti tranp
• epek samit se pahle kaisi hain taiyariyan
• yukren aur rus ke bich hamle jari
• pakistan ke purv piem imran khan ne ki apil
Prezentar – sarika sinh
Prodyusar – kirti rajora, ashvani pasvan, vidit mehra
